name: sim_weyl_group_g2_shell_local
scope_note: Shell-local probe: Weyl group W(G2) = Dih6 (order 12), G2 root system. 12 roots = 6 short (A2 sub-system) + 6 long (length ratio sqrt(3)). Cartan matrix [[2,-1],[-3,2]]. Coxeter order exactly 6. W(A2) = S3 is a subgroup of W(G2) = Dih6. z3 UNSAT: G2 Cartan entry -3 with Coxeter order 3 (like A2) is impossible.

pytorch.reason: Represent all 12 G2 roots as 2D float64 tensors; apply all 12 Weyl group elements; verify two 6-element orbits (short and long roots); confirm that inner 6 roots match A2 pattern; check (s1*s2)^6 = I numerically

pyg.reason: not used in this Weyl geometry shell-local probe; deferred to coupling sims

z3.reason: UNSAT: (s1*s2)^3 = identity AND this is G2; G2 Coxeter order is 6 not 3; encode as: a G2-type system has Coxeter order=6, (s1s2)^3=I implies order<=3 which is A2, contradicting the G2 Cartan entry -3

cvc5.reason: not used in this Weyl geometry shell-local probe; deferred to coupling sims

sympy.reason: G2 Cartan matrix [[2,-1],[-3,2]]; compute simple reflections s_i(lambda) = lambda - <lambda,alpha_i^v>*alpha_i; verify (s1*s2)^6 = I symbolically; confirm (s1*s2)^3 != I (distinguishes G2 from A2)

clifford.reason: G2 roots in Cl(2,0); Clifford reflections s_alpha(v) = -alpha*v*alpha^{-1}/|alpha|^2; verify all 12 roots; confirm long root length = sqrt(3) * short root length; verify Clifford composition of 6 reflections gives identity

P1_pytorch_g2_root_count_12.reason: G2 has 12 roots: 6 short + 6 long; generated by W(G2) acting on simple roots

P2_pytorch_weyl_group_order_12.reason: W(G2) = Dih6 has order 12; generated by two reflections with Coxeter order 6

P3_pytorch_two_orbits_short_long.reason: G2 has two orbits: 6 short (|alpha|^2=1) and 6 long (|alpha|^2=3); ratio = sqrt(3)

P4_pytorch_short_roots_are_a2.reason: G2 short roots = A2 root system (inner hexagon); the A2 sub-root-system is nested in G2

P5_pytorch_a2_subgroup_in_g2.reason: All 6 elements of W(A2) appear in W(G2): A2 is a sub-root-system, S3 < Dih6

P6_pytorch_coxeter_order_6.reason: (s1*s2)^6 = I for G2; Coxeter order = 6 (largest for rank-2; G2 is most constrained)

P7_sympy_g2_cartan_matrix.reason: G2 Cartan [[2,-1],[-3,2]]; A_{21}=-3 encodes sqrt(3) root length ratio (unique among rank-2)

P8_sympy_coxeter_relation_s1s2_order_6.reason: (s1*s2)^6 = I symbolically verified for G2 Cartan matrix; Coxeter order exactly 6

P9_clifford_short_roots_map_to_g2_roots.reason: Clifford reflection of each short G2 root by s1 maps to another G2 root

P10_clifford_long_root_length_ratio_sqrt.reason: Long G2 root length = sqrt(3) * short root length; unique among rank-2 Lie algebras

P11_rustworkx_cayley_graph_12_nodes_conn.reason: Cayley graph of W(G2) = Dih6: 12 nodes, strongly connected, 24 directed edges

P12_xgi_coxeter_and_a2_nesting_hyperedge.reason: XGI: hyperedges for Coxeter relation, A2 subgroup nesting, short/long root coupling

N1_pytorch_s1s2_cubed_not_identity.reason: (s1*s2)^3 != I for G2; order 3 would imply A2 — G2 is strictly larger (order 6)

N2_pytorch_s1s2_fourth_not_identity.reason: (s1*s2)^4 != I for G2; order 4 would imply B2 — G2 has Coxeter order 6

N3_z3_unsat_g2_coxeter_not_3.reason: UNSAT: G2 Cartan |A12*A21|=3 implies Coxeter order 6; claiming order=3 contradicts this

N4_pytorch_order_not_6_or_8.reason: W(G2) has order 12: not 6 (A2), not 8 (B2); G2 is the largest exceptional rank-2 group

N5_sympy_s1s2_cubed_not_identity.reason: (s1*s2)^3 != I symbolically for G2; confirms Coxeter order > 3

N6_clifford_long_roots_not_in_a2.reason: Long G2 roots are NOT in the A2 (short root) set: two distinct root orbits

B4_sympy_coxeter_order_exactly_6.reason: (s1*s2)^6 = I AND (s1*s2)^3 != I: Coxeter order is exactly 6 for G2

B5_z3_sat_g2_cartan_a21_minus3.reason: SAT: G2 Cartan entry A_{21}=-3 is consistent; encodes sqrt(3) length ratio
